title: DW3 port stages/s<nnn>/tiles/tiles.json (stages-tiles-v1)
description: The descriptor of one original stage's background tiles (data/stages/s<nnn>/tiles/: tiles.json and one PNG per tile). Written by the exporter from the disc's S<nnn>PACK.BIN (pc/shim/stage_export.c, jsonTile). Descriptive: no code parses it (the exporter only checks that it exists to know the stage is exported); a mod replaces a tile by putting a PNG of the same name in mods/<mod>/stages/s<nnn>/tiles/. Editing this file changes nothing.

pack.description: The disc's archive the tiles come from, such as S202PACK.

width.description: Tiles per row of the stage's grid.

tileBytes.description: Size of one tile's slot in the archive, in bytes.

frame.description: Index of the tile in the archive (row * width + col).

png.description: The tile's picture, <row>_<col>.png, in the same folder.

size.description: The tile's size in the archive, in bytes.

rle.description: True when the tile is stored run-length encoded.

timOffset.description: Where the tile's TIM picture starts inside the tile, in bytes.

width.description: Size of the PNG in pixels.

depths.description: The three depth layers of the tile (behind the actors, with them, in front), each the list of sprites the game cuts out of the picture.

x.description: Where the sprite is drawn, in the tile, in pixels.

u.description: Where it is cut from, in the tile's picture, in pixels.
